title: On a Weiss-type Almost Monotonicity Formula
summary: We establish a Weiss-type almost-monotonicity formula for a broad class of variable-coefficient energy functionals, assuming only minimal regularity of the coefficients. As an application, we classify blow-up limits for the Alt--Phillips problem with variable coefficients under significantly weaker regularity hypotheses than those imposed in Araújo et al. [Calc. Var. Partial Differential Equations, 65, no.~1, Paper No.~24 (2026)]. Moreover, by means of a distinct argument, we extend the corresponding free-boundary regularity result.
